$comment: Link mapping from ai-tools to every consumer. 'link' is the path that must exist; 'target' is what it points at. type: symlink (dir/file symlink, needs admin or dev mode) | junction (dirs only). mode: 'link' = single link; 'perFile' = one link per file in 'target' dir matching 'include' (minus 'exclude'). ${var} expands from 'vars'. Generated skill junctions inside src are owned by tools/linkSkills/sync.ps1, not listed here.
